release_notes: OneMira C1 1.1.62 adds an optional host-selected live BLE audio profile for Windows on 27- and 80-octet links, preserves legacy macOS START behavior when the selector is absent, and retains the unacknowledged live tail for TF backfill after Stop. Low-voltage battery hardware validation remains unvalidated; this release is authorized for real-device power/recording evidence only.
